offering_description.value: Owns and operates regulated water and wastewater utilities in Arizona, selling potable water and sewer service to homes and businesses. Also sells recycled water and water resource management services to developers and communities, delivered through wells, pipelines, treatment plants and recharge facilities.

primary_services.value: wastewater collection and treatment; water resource management; water reclamation

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential homeowners in master-planned communities; B2B: commercial and industrial users, developers, agricultural users

end_markets.value: residential real estate; commercial development; agriculture; utilities

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: metered water and sewer charges billed to customers; service fees: connection, meter and wastewater service charges
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: runs wells, treatment plants and pipe networks, sells water and sewer service to end customers

geography_served.value: US regional: Arizona: Phoenix metro area, Pinal County and Sun City communities

specialization.value: related lines: water supply, wastewater, recycled water and water resource management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility billing directly to residential and commercial customers; other: developer agreements for new service connections

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Arizona Corporation Commission sets utility rates and service, ADEQ and EPA water quality and discharge permits

notes: Business lines and service area reflect general knowledge and may have changed.
